angle.hook: a horror game adds a bright rainbow location that loses its colour as you go
angle.why_now: Frag Lab posted the Rainbow update on Steam on 13 Nov and the PS5 version was announced the same day
angle.what_it_means_here: Gulf PC players get the update now (Steam AED price 26.20 with 20 percent off per the page); no PS5 date and no Arabic
angle.payoff: the five-stage puzzle and the new boss at the end of the rainbow

bed_reason: Steam trailer 'Last Train: Forest Escape - New Rainbow Location' (appid 4090360, movie 257505172, 58 s, the only trailer of the Rainbow update) opened and run through the audio split on the server: music stem 59 to 64% of the track but silent from about 11.0 s of the Reel (measured -43 to -75 dBFS in the last 1.5 s before the end card) in both a music_only and a split-with-effects render; the clean picture stretches come from moments 0 to 13 s and 41 to 46 s, so no single continuous stretch of its music covers the 12.6 s cut; so our bed. Other trailers of the game (Halloween update, EA release, demo) were not opened for sound
pace_ok: the 7.15-12.55 s shot is one continuous stretch of the trailer that itself changes every 1.5 to 2 s (gnome, a dissolve to balloons, a focus pull to the toy tree); merged to avoid crossfades eating the 12 s length
